summary: Episode 32 summarizes trading year 2025 including defense rally, Trump tariff volatility, and small cap liquidity issues. Outrageous calls include Sam Altman arrest and crypto crash. Main investment pitches for 2026: Camurus (biotech platform with phase 3 catalyst) and Scandic Hotels (momentum play on turnaround).
key_takeaways: Stay away from companies with misleading management communications
Buy dips in liquid companies during volatility, not small caps
Cheap stocks with problems can get much cheaper
Momentum should not be underestimated in Swedish investments
